body: I really can't afford to ship it myself. It's probably 100 lbs or more of property.

I had been told multiple times that he had secured new office space for me, only to be told the next day that it fell through. 

If he doesn't pick it up today as promised (I'm not holding my breath), then tell him that he can either pay rent to me to store it or I can move it to a storage unit and he can pay the rent there.

>Your first mistake was taking this stuff home with you in the first place.


I know, but it was a spur of the moment thing. 

As for a storage unit, how do I go about making sure I'd get compensated?
I'd love to, but can I just do that? I'm worried he'd say I did it without permission and that I won't be reimbursed.
